items.title: Before
items.text: We meet to talk through the venue, the number of guests, the shots you want and your budget, and write up a clear list of objectives.

sections.title: Meet *Brian and Sheryl*

image.alt: Brian and Sheryl of Argus Visuals on a clifftop high above the sea

body: Argus Visuals began in June 2020 as a creative outlet and a way to serve the community after long careers in automation packaging and education. We soon found how much it costs a small business to hire a digital marketing professional, and saw that the CSRA needed high-quality media at a reasonable rate.

Between us we have over thirty years of digital media and customer service experience. We’re incorporated with business licenses in South Carolina and Georgia, and insured as professional photographers, videographers and FAA-certified Part 107 drone pilots. We treat our customers how we want to be treated.
list: Hard hats and hi-vis on every job site

items.text: I could not have asked for a better company and couple to capture my son’s proposal! Brian and Sheryl were absolutely fabulous to work with! My son and I met with them prior to the big day and they helped him plan every detail. It was a perfect day!

items.a: Yes. We’re FAA-certified Part 107 drone pilots, and we carry commercial insurance for photo, video and drone work.

items.q: Are floor plans included for real estate?
items.a: Yes, 2D floor plans come with every interior real estate shoot.

items.q: Can you work on an active construction site?
items.a: Yes. We arrive with safety boots, high-visibility vests and hard hats, and we won’t interfere with your crew’s progress.
Yes. We’re licensed in both South Carolina and Georgia. Call (706) 405-2248 for our Georgia line.

items.q: Can you help with social media posts after an event?
items.a: Yes. Along with your gallery, we can match photos with their captions so they’re ready to post.
